speaker: margery_pell
text: Lawyers, lawyers' men, two aldermen's wives and a horse-courser. Thirty-three shillings in mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not cast. I am in the door, which is as far as I go. They laugh before a line is done. They have guessed it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then stay in the door. Guessing is still a sixpence. I am not your audience, Master Shakespeare. I am the stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Young men at their books. These are those men. I am not putting a comedy on your stair.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Four weeks is not my stair. Thirty-three shillings is. Mind your feet. I have a horse-courser still to count, and he argues.
